data.headline: QNB Corp net loans rose 33.8% quarter over quarter

claims.text: QNB Corp's QNB Bank net loans and leases reached $1.70 billion, up 33.8% quarter over quarter.

citation.quote: Loans and leases, net of unearned income and allowance 1703859 1273272 1209410

claims.text: QNB Corp primarily provides banking services to customers in Bucks, Lehigh and Montgomery Counties in Pennsylvania.

citation.quote: QNB primarily provides banking services to customers located in the Bucks, Lehigh and Montgomery Counties in Pennsylvania.

claims.text: QNB Corp says its local operating model makes it more affected by adverse local economic conditions than larger, more geographically diversified banks.

citation.quote: Unlike larger banks that are more geographically diversified, we provide banking and financial services locally and therefore are more affected by adverse local economic conditions.

claims.text: QNB Corp says declining local real estate values can reduce collateral values and customers’ ability to repay loans.

citation.quote: Economic factors impacting the local economy with this region, such as a decline in real estate values, unemployment, natural disasters, or the effects of armed conflict in other parts of the world, including present armed conflicts in Ukraine and the Gaza Strip, may have a negative impact on credit-worthiness of customers, the value of collateral, and customers’ ability to repay loans
